title: Motion (Soto-Martinez - Jurado) relative to the evaluation of the following three City-owned sites and parking lots in Council District 13 as potential high…
text:
[Council File 26-1606; CD 13]
Motion (Soto-Martinez - Jurado) relative to the evaluation of the following three City-owned sites and parking lots in Council District 13 as potential high density mixed-use redevelopment opportunities: the municipal office and adjacent parking lots located at 6501 Fountain Avenue; the former Los Angeles Department of Transportation (LADOT) office located at 411 North Vermont Avenue; and, the contiguous LADOT Public Parking Lot Nos. 622, 663, and 643 located behind Sunset Boulevard between Lemoyne Street and Echo Park Avenue, and the adjacent City-owned land located at 1140 - 1155 North Lemoyne Street. (This matter is also referred to the Economic Development and Jobs Committee. The Economic Development and Jobs Committee approved the item on November 20, 2026.)
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Asks staff to evaluate three City-owned sites in Council District 13 for possible high-density mixed-use redevelopment, including a municipal office at 6501 Fountain Avenue, a former LADOT office at 411 North Vermont Avenue, and public parking lots and adjacent land near Sunset Boulevard and Lemoyne Street.
